parsed_json.up: Select the first 1000 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1615388 (SUMO-activating enzyme subunit 1). Filter for IC50 activities where standard_relation is '=' and pchembl_value is not null. Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate rows.
